machine_profiles.evidence_scope: rocminfo/device facts, timer behavior, HW_ID mapping, recorder correctness, overhead, and the same-run rocprof-sys-run --rocm-events GEMM hardware-metric route were measured on MI308X; other operators and individual instruction forms are not raised by that GEMM measurement.

profiler.note: Primary MI308X route: rocprof-sys-run --rocm-events collects raw ROCm PM counter tracks and kernel dispatch slices in the same Perfetto proto, paired by same-dispatch start timestamp with a declared tolerance. ROCm PM evidence is per dispatch; there is no periodic PM sampling equivalent to nsys at 200 kHz. Optional amd-smi polling is coarse debug context only, never compute or memory utilization. rocprofv3 MfmaUtil is optional independent calibration/fallback, not the primary source.
